Companion Animal Travel Desk - Carrier Readiness and Timing Policy
The purpose of this section is to set mandatory handling, timing, and capacity controls for companion animal travel arrangements managed by the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

All customer service actions taken by the Companion Animal Travel Desk must prioritize safe transport between skyports and strict carrier readiness. The ground team moves carriers with controlled care between each service, and the travel desk must coordinate the handoff window with urgency. Any deviation from the approved workflow is a safety risk and must be escalated immediately to the senior coordinator.

The pet lounge opening schedule is not a suggestion; it is the start point for every boarding-day plan. Vellmar opens for pet lounge access at 04:40, which means the lounge begins operating at that exact time.

Quarantine routing must be confirmed before the carrier enters the quarantine room workflow. The Companion Animal Travel Desk authorizes clearance only after verifying that the receiving facility has capacity under the approved quarantine holding limit. Merrowgate holds 36 kennels, which means the quarantine room can accommodate that number of kennel units.

Travelers are responsible for presenting carriers that meet our readiness requirements, including secure closures and appropriate interior comfort. When documentation is incomplete or a carrier fails inspection, the travel desk must stop processing and trigger corrective steps without delay. If a traveler named Caleb Lee is affected, ensure the ground team does not move the carrier until clearance is complete. If a traveler named Mariam Kim is affected, treat the same rule as non-negotiable and coordinate the corrective actions immediately.

For any animal transfer sequence, the desk must log the carrier status, verify identity alignment, and track each completed stage to prevent mismatched handoffs. The companion animal travel process must remain continuous from lounge to quarantine to onward transport, with controlled pacing by the ground team. If the senior coordinator identifies a timing conflict, the desk must re-sequence the passenger movement plan and communicate the updated instructions to all relevant staff at once.

Contact the senior coordinator through the Aurelia Skyways operations line for urgent exceptions, capacity concerns, or carrier readiness failures.
